messages:
amanda: Starting intake for Halcyon-12B (external upstream from HalcyonAI). Scope: model catalog entry, public docs/model card, quant experiments, evals, and announcement/release coordination. tagging @juan @lee @tara for owners.

juan: SGTM. I'll own quant experiments. Plan to run int8 (A100) baseline + nf4/4-bit static on T4. Will try QAT if we see big quality drop.

lee: I'll own the eval harness. Proposed matrix: MMLU (subset), GSM8K, Chain-of-thought consistency, prompt-sensitivity sweep, and latency/regression checks vs our current production 13B. Baseline runs in fp16 first.

tara: I can write the model card and quickstart docs. Need: recommended prompts, safety notes, intended-usage, and known failure modes. Will draft and request review.

amanda: Owners confirmed: docs @tara, quant @juan, evals @lee, rollout infra @marco, marketing heads-up @olivia. Please add expected ETA for first draft/benchmarks.

juan: ETA for initial quant artifacts: 4 days. Will upload quant binaries + quant config to s3://redwood-models/halcyon-12b/quant/ and link in the thread. Quick note: initial int8 runs look promising on throughput.

lee: ETA for first eval run: 3 days. Running a 1000-sample MMLU subset overnight. Quick config I used: 
```json
{"model":"halcyon-12b","evals":["mmlu_subset","cot_consistency","gsm8k"],"batch_size":8,"seq_len":1024,"seed":42}
```
Posting raw logs to /evals/halcyon-12b/ in the usual bucket.

marco: Canary rollout plan proposal: start at 5% traffic for 48h, run both fp16 and best quantized variant in A/B. Metrics to watch: latency p50/p95, unsuccessful completions, generation-quality delta (eval set), and customer error rate. If quality regression <2% and latency within target, ramp to 25% over 24h, then to 100% after 72h stable.

olivia: Marketing note: we need a 7-day heads-up for channel teams and a 48h final sign-off on docs. I'll draft a short blurb once the model card exists. Also need a short feature matrix (cost delta, latency expectations, recommended use cases).

amanda: Action items (compact):
- tara: draft model card + quickstart (48h)
- juan: quant artifacts + perf numbers (4d)
- lee: full eval report (3d)
- marco: create canary job + dashboard (2d)
- olivia: marketing blurb draft (after tara docs)
Please add if anything missing.

juan: Added: I'll include a small script for converting HF weights -> nf4 Q4 static and a short README for operators.

lee: FYI, early eval shows hallucination rate on COT probes slightly higher vs our current baseline; will quantify. Might need small prompt-engineering guidance in the model card.

tara: Noted. I'll add a "prompting tips" section and a short example of recommended system message + few-shot template.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: scheduled canary created for halcyon-12b at 2026-04-05T10:00Z — canary-id: canary-halcyon-1769871234

amanda: Perfect — let's keep thread for blockers only. If something blocks an owner, ping here and add the label `urgent-onboard` in the PR. :white_check_mark:
thread_summary: Intake thread for Halcyon-12B onboarding: owners assigned for docs, quant, evals, rollout; canary plan set; action items and ETAs listed.
